scope: QuartzDriver follow plus ActorSwing springs, captured dynamic/static colliders, and inferred skirt/jacket rings. Collider offsets are baked from Unity rest into PMX/THREE local space when rest+skeleton are supplied. Dynamic collider masks/radii come from the captured NativeList when supplied; game assemblies are not executed.

derivedFrom.kept: hair springs, hair drivers and all colliders (hair uses the identical mdl_chr_hkne-base-0000_hair)
derivedFrom.dropped: body springs, body drivers and skirt chains: they were captured on mdl_chr_hkne-othr-0004_body, not the hume-othr-0000 onsen body
derivedFrom.limitation: onsen body cloth has no secondary motion until a capture of mdl_chr_hume-othr-0000_body exists; collider offsets come from the hkne-othr-0004 body
